thread:
arya: Morning — noticed spike of unassigned webinar leads, ~3.9k in intake. HubSpot enrichment lagging, RR slot claim failing SLA. Anyone on call?

ben: I'm seeing the same. enrichment-worker-2 stuck on IO, jobs piling up after the 02:50 deploy. Requeued ~600 leads to force retry.

noah: Is our webinar fast-path not firing? I thought we had an override when enrichment takes too long.

laura: It exists but it's gated by enrichment_status == "complete". Because the enrichment pipeline is delayed, those leads never flip and then hit the 45-minute SLA.

arya: Proposal: new temporary rule for HubSpot -> set RoutingOverride = fastpath_overflow when (Original_Source = "webinar") AND (Minutes_Since_Ingest > 0.5) AND (Enrichment_Status != "complete"). Overflow pool gets TTL=120s, then back to normal flow.

ben: Also add slot_jitter_ms = 1500 on RR assignment to avoid spike when backlog drains. And cap per-rep claim retries to 3 to avoid clogging.

noah: Draft Salesforce automation to mirror HubSpot change:
```
IF Lead_Source__c = 'Webinar' AND Enrichment_Complete__c = False AND Age_Minutes__c > 1
THEN Owner = 'Overflow Team' AND Overflow_TTL__c = 2
```
We should also add an OwnerHistory flag to auto-revert after TTL.

laura: I'll temp bump HS webhook timeout 5s -> 10s during the mitigation to reduce transient webhook errors.

deploy-bot: Started canary rollout for routing-service v1.43.0 to 10% of traffic (4 pods). CI: https://ci.redwood/roll/518888

ben: Monitoring: set alert on unclaimed_leads > 150/min and enrichment_queue_len > 400. watching assign_latency p95/p99.

arya: After 15m bake, if metrics look good promote to 100% and we'll publish the quick playbook note in #help and update the inbound routing doc. Also send heads-up to Sales Ops.

noah: Prelim root cause: enrichment scheduler collision with large batch job + no RR jitter. Action items: stagger enrichment batches, add backpressure signal from enrichment to intake, and implement the fastpath rule as fallback.

laura: I'll draft the HubSpot workflow snippet and push a small playbook entry.

arya: Thanks team — please keep thread updates here. I'll send a short email to sales-ops and ops-responders once we hit 100%. :thumbsup:

[end thread]
